parse_artifact_from_json: parse a JSON string into a LoadArtifactResponse dataclass with artifact fields
test_artifact_full_parse: test that LoadArtifactResponse.from_json correctly parses all artifact fields including uri, id, name, desc, type, tags, version, and isZipped
test_artifact_default_values: test that LoadArtifactResponse.from_json uses ARTIFACT_OBJECT_TYPE_UNSPECIFIED as the default when artifactObjectType is omitted
test_artifact_none_values: test that LoadArtifactResponse.from_json handles null JSON values by setting all fields to None except artifactObjectType which defaults to UNSPECIFIED
test_artifact_empty_values_raises: test that LoadArtifactResponse.from_json raises ValueError when all fields are provided as empty strings or empty lists
